title: Filtered Derivative (Discrete or Continuous)
text: 离散时间或连续时间滤波导数，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；{Gain} 指定微分增益、{Time constant} 指定导数时间常数、{Upper saturation limit} 输出上限 inf、{Lower saturation limit} 输出下限 -inf、{Minimum sample time to time constant ratio} 指定离散比率、{Initialization} 指定初始状态指定 Inherited from block、{Initial state} 指定初始状态、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Time constant
params.values: 导数时间常数 0.1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: 输出上限 inf (default) | real number

params.name: Minimum sample time to time constant ratio
Initialization
params.values: 初始状态指定 Inherited from block input (default) | Specify as parameter

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | positive number
